title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-09-draft
content:
Weekly sync — serving-runtime / infra / console (Mon 2026-03-09)
Owner: Ava Chen
Attendees (expected): Ava, Liam, Priya, Marco, Sasha, Rahul
Status: draft (prep notes & action tracking)

Agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: Quick status + blockers (round-robin)
  - note: emphasize SLO regressions seen Fri night for 1s p50 on text-gen routes
- 5-12m: Incident recap: autoscaler flapping (INF-412)
  - Priya to summarise root cause (suspected task eviction during spot reclaim)
  - Action: Priya -> postmortem draft by Wed 2026-03-11 (owner: Priya)
- 12-18m: Batching + latency tuning experiments
  - Marco update on dynamic batching perf (PR #298)
  - Decision needed: enable dynamic batching for low-qps model pool?
  - Action: Marco -> run 24h A/B on canary pool; report in next sync (owner: Marco)
- 18-24m: Console dashboard tweaks (cost breakdown per route)
  - Sasha requested an annotation layer to surface quantization status per model
  - Action: Sasha -> mockups in Figma and ticket (due: 2026-03-13)
- 24-28m: Private deployments checklist (onboarding checklist final review)
  - Ava to present current gaps (KMS rotation docs, network egress tests)
  - Action: Ava -> update checklist + add KMS rotation doc link (done by 2026-03-12)
- 28-30m: Parking lot & quick wins

Prep notes / talking points:
- Autoscaler: we saw ~20% increase in eviction events after kernel update; infra suspects pod qos change. Link to logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/evictions/2026-03-06
- Dynamic batching perf: PR 298 shows 12% token/sec improvement but 1.4x p95 latency for short sequences. Need to tune max_batch_delay threshold.
- Console: cost breakdown appears correct for hosted routes, but dedicated allocations missing line items for reserved GPU amortization. Finance asks for estimated monthly amortization by next Wed.

Action items (tracking table):
- PRIYA_DESAI: postmortem draft for INF-412 -- due 2026-03-11 -- status: in_progress
- MARCO_GIORDANO: run 24h dynamic-batching A/B on canary pool -- due 2026-03-16 -- status: todo
- SASHA_ALI: console mockups + ticket for quantization annotation -- due 2026-03-13 -- status: todo
- AVA_CHEN: update private-deploy checklist & add KMS rotation doc -- due 2026-03-12 -- status: todo
- LIAM_ONEILL: follow up with infra on kernel rollback plan -- due 2026-03-10 -- status: todo

Notes to self:
- Bring SLA numbers for p50/p95 for hosted vs dedicated (quick slide)
- Ask Finance contact (Elena) about GPU amortization model; ping in #finance on Monday morning
- If Priya needs help with the postmortem, allocate 2h for troubleshooting historical logs

Related artifacts / refs:
- INF incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-412
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/298
- Previous agendas: users/weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-04.json

End of doc. Add to team calendar: 30m block weekly, Monday 11:00-11:30 PT.
